##### Project general facts

Maseel Phase 1 is a beachfront master community conceived around the idea of architecture that breathes with the sea. The planning positions residential buildings, townhouses and villas so that sea views open up from every component, including the rear sides of the residential buildings. The residential offer spans apartments, townhouses with garden views, garden villas, beach villas with direct beach access and water-breaker villas, complemented by retail, dining and everyday services within the community.

Waterfront living sits at the centre of the amenity offer, with gated beach access, a marina and yacht dock, floating sports courts, a round lagoon with a waterfall, a splash park, swimming pools and dedicated zones for water activities and leisure. Green spaces include a central community park, a butterfly park, sky gardens, rooftop green spaces, picnic areas and shaded pathways. Sports and wellness facilities comprise padel, tennis and basketball courts, a running track, a gym, a spa with sauna, an outdoor cinema and a kids’ play area, while a community mosque, nursery, clinic, co-working space, entertainment hall, panoramic rooftop restaurant and barber and beauty salons cover daily needs.

Residences are thoughtfully designed to make the most of their coastal setting, with layouts oriented towards open sea and garden outlooks. The interiors feature contemporary finishes and high-quality materials, creating a calm and balanced atmosphere for everyday living. Each residence is delivered fully furnished, offering a move-in-ready home that combines comfort, style, and convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Mairid is a coastal area of Ras Al Khaimah set along the waterfront near Khor Al Mairid, close to the Al Mairid breakwater and the local fish market. The area combines an open beachfront setting with quick access to the main highway, linking it to the rest of the emirate and to neighbouring emirates.

Shopping malls and golf clubs are a short drive away, while Al Marjan Island with the Wynn resort and the Jebel Jais mountain can be reached comfortably by car. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is the closest air hub, with Sharjah and Dubai international airports accessible by road. The surroundings offer camping sites, fishing points, beach clubs and dining, nature trails, desert safaris and glamping, birdwatching spots, heritage sites, mountain adventures and hot air balloon rides.

Ras Al Khaimah attracts growing attention as a leisure and tourism destination, supported by large-scale hospitality on Al Marjan Island and outdoor attractions such as Jebel Jais. Beachfront communities with direct sea access, a marina and resort-style facilities in this setting appeal both to end users seeking a calmer coastal lifestyle and to investors targeting holiday and long-term rental demand.
